_comment: Bifrost configuration for the gateway benchmark.
Points at the same mock upstream every other gateway uses.
Bifrost is the raw-speed comparison, so nothing here is tuned to slow it
down: no extra plugins, no logging, default pool sizing.
allow_private_network is required: Bifrost v2 refuses to connect to private
IPs by default (an SSRF guard), and every gateway in this benchmark talks to
a mock upstream on a Docker bridge network. Without it every request fails
with 'connection to private IP ... is not allowed'. This is a benchmark-only
setting; do not copy it into a production config.
base_url deliberately omits the /v1 suffix: Bifrost appends /v1/chat/completions
itself, so including it produces /p/primary/v1/v1/chat/completions and a 404.
